purpose: Small computational ledger separating extreme points, extreme directions, recession, and lineality.

entries.face_test: active support rows identify vertices and edges
a half-line face gives an extreme direction
nonzero lineality prevents isolated extreme points

entries.decomposition: closed convex hull of exposed approximants plus ray closure
entries.face_test: recession direction need not appear as a half-line face

numeric_certificate_rule: For a polyhedron {x: A x <= b}, a candidate face F_I is certified by equalities A_I x = b_I and strict slacks on inactive rows for a relative-interior witness.
